name: radio-esgoto
description: Rádio Esgoto: chat desktop privado em tempo real

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate --prefix server && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate --prefix client
